# resolve_one { #crossrepo.core.resolve_one }

```python
crossrepo.core.resolve_one(entries, spec)
```

Find the single entry a spec refers to.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**entries**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[List](`typing.List`)\[[Entry](`crossrepo.model.Entry`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Catalog to search.

<code>[**spec**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Spec](`crossrepo.model.Spec`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Reference to resolve.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Entry](`crossrepo.model.Entry`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The matching entry.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[LookupError](`LookupError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If nothing matches, or if several entries do. The message lists the candidates as full specs, so the ambiguity can be resolved by copying one of them.
